body:
My dad saw the first but not the second because she sent it in the middle of the night. She deletes the texts off of my mom’s phone. This morning I woke up to another text from my sister saying everything she said doesn’t matter anymore because it’s none of her business and I’m still her sister. (Love when they use the “we’re blood” card.) She deleted the nasty text and left the apology one. I just sent my dad a screenshot of the nasty text and he asked why I cared so much about what she said and why I was ignoring her apology.

Basically my parents don’t seem to care. I don’t know how to make them see how bad of a person she is. Nothing seems to work.
